name: okm-football-academie
description: Site officiel et espace d'administration de OKM Football Académie (Cloudflare Pages + D1 + R2).

scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply okm-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply okm-db --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && npx wrangler d1 execute okm-db --local --file=seed/demo.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && npx wrangler d1 execute okm-db --remote --file=seed/demo.sql
scripts.db:unseed:local: node scripts/build-seed.mjs remove && npx wrangler d1 execute okm-db --local --file=seed/demo-remove.sql
scripts.db:unseed:remote: node scripts/build-seed.mjs remove && npx wrangler d1 execute okm-db --remote --file=seed/demo-remove.sql
scripts.build: echo "Aucun build necessaire : site statique (public) + functions"
